funds_data.description: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its assets (net assets plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in securitized assets, which include commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS), asset-backed securities (ABS), agency and non-agency residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS), collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs), and collateralized loan obligations (CLOs).
